audit.why: Difficulty 7.5/10 with a 52.17% Illaoi win rate over 1014 games fits a lane Pantheon owns levels 1-3 and loses from 4 onward.
audit.corrected: Kept TRICKY; sharpened the early-lane text to name Shield Vault's 13s cooldown and its auto-attack reset as the tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: The stored level chart marked Level 2 'Skill', Level 3 'Illaoi' and Level 6 'Pantheon', contradicting the packet chart and the page's own prose (whys[2] says level 3 is in his favour; whys[4] and spikes[1] say 6 is yours).
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Pantheon/Pantheon/Pantheon/Illaoi/Illaoi/Illaoi/Illaoi. Grand Starfall is 180s at rank 1 and a map tool; Illaoi's R inside the tentacle field is the duel spike.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 3 and 6 flipped on both layers as one atomic group with matching ratings and whys.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never said Shield Vault opens with an auto-attack reset, never gave a cooldown number for it, and never mentioned Aegis Assault at all.
audit.why: Riot text: Shield Vault dashes to a target, damaging and stunning them (13/12/11/10/9s, auto reset flagged); Aegis Assault makes him 'invulnerable to damage from the front' — so the block is directional, not omnidirectional.
audit.corrected: Shield Vault named as a 13s dash-stun whose auto-reset wind-up is the cue; Aegis Assault named as front-only so you reposition rather than trade into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns tracked Shield Vault with no number.
audit.why: 13s at rank 1 makes the punish window concrete.
audit.corrected: Number and the auto-reset tell added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Illaoi's R carries derived flags 'grounding' and 'untargetable' in the kit file that Riot's own description does not support.
audit.why: Riot text for Harsh Lesson/R: 'Illaoi smashes her idol into the ground, dealing physical damage to nearby enemies. A Tentacle spawns for each enemy champion hit.' No grounding, no untargetability.
audit.corrected: No claim written from those flags; recorded here instead.

edits.before: Landing E changes the lane — his soul fuels your field. Only take the trade when Pantheon's Shield Vault is down.
edits.after: His Shield Vault leap-stun into Comet Spear wins the level-2 all-in before tentacles exist. Trade after that 13s dash.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Pantheon must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Your kit is online but Test of Spirit is 16s against his 13s W — he still out-cycles you. Hold the wave near your side until level 4.

edits.before: Leap of Faith inside your tentacle field is a 1v3 button. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Pantheon's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Your R inside the tentacle field is a 1v3 button, and Grand Starfall is a 180s map tool, not a duel button. The extended all-in is yours.

edits.before: His all-in start. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: A 13s dash-stun at rank 1 that opens with an auto reset. Engage after.

edits.before: That is Pantheon's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Shield Vault is 13s at rank 1 and resets his auto — refuse it and half his win goes.

edits.before: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — His all-in start. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Pantheon Shield Vault: matchup-defining — 13s dash-stun at 1, opens with an auto reset. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: By 6 you're ahead: R Leap of Faith drops the tentacle ring and gives you the bulk to eat his combo and win the extended fight. Pantheon's R Grand Starfall is a roam/global tool, not a duel button, so a full commit favours you.
edits.after: By 6 you're ahead: R drops the tentacle ring and gives you the bulk to eat his combo and win the extended fight. Grand Starfall is a 180s roam tool, not a duel button, and Aegis Assault only blocks damage from the front — step around it.
